newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis up, domestic trade slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Basis up, domestic trade slow.

text.p: Soymeal basis offers continued to climb in some areas but brokers said the values were nominal with little meal available in the domestic market.
"Nobody has anything to sell," a Tennessee broker said. "It's amazingly quiet for this time of year. The firm tone has killed the domestic market."
Some brokers said they were advising domestic customers to continue buying hand-to-mouth until basis values recede.
But export demand remained strong. CIF and FOB values both rose by $1.00 per ton and there was talk a major Illinois processor was looking for barges, brokers said.

Soybean supplies were tight in some areas as rains delayed harvest but heavy winds that lashed much of the U.S. Midwest Tuesday night and Wednesday were helping to dry fields, a Kentucky broker noted.
"We needed some wind to dry out the fields and lower the moisture level," he said.
